author: Ddemon26
message:
Add AGENTS.md with automated agent ruleset

Introduces AGENTS.md specifying strict rules and guidelines for LLM/Codex-style autonomous agents contributing to the repository. The document covers allowed operations, commit message format, code style, testing, security, and escalation protocols to ensure safe and maintainable automated contributions.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Convert rule lists in AGENTS.md to bullet points

Replaces dash-prefixed rule lists with asterisk-prefixed bullet points for consistency and readability. Also adds a new section on de-obfuscation and safe renaming, outlining mandatory steps and safeguards for renaming poorly named identifiers.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Update agent rules for offline Maven builds and renaming

Clarifies that all Maven verification must be run in offline mode due to CI network restrictions, and adds a new section detailing network constraints and offline build strategies. Expands and strengthens the rules for de-obfuscation and safe renaming, requiring all ambiguous identifiers in a class to be renamed together and enforcing stricter project-wide reference updates.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Update renaming protocol for batch class refactors

Revises the renaming workflow to allow small batches of top-level classes per PR instead of one at a time. Clarifies naming conventions, requiring agents to understand and clearly describe identifiers, and updates branch/PR naming guidelines to reflect batch operations.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Add exception for large class renames in agent rules

Introduces a 'God-class exception' for classes ≥10,000 LOC, allowing renames to be split into multiple PRs with specific guidelines for each phase. This clarifies the process for handling extremely large classes while maintaining code quality and reviewability.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Update build/test requirements for Maven-based PRs

Clarifies that Maven-based pull requests must skip test execution due to sandbox network restrictions, requiring only compilation checks. Updates guidelines for large class renames and details alternative test runner requirements if provided.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Update agent rules for clarification via draft PRs

Replaces references to opening Issues for clarifications with instructions to open draft PRs titled 'AI-Clarification: <topic>' with no code changes. Updates related language throughout to reflect this new process, ensuring agents follow a consistent and reviewable clarification workflow.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Update agent rules: enforce compilation before PR

Added a requirement that all Java sources must compile cleanly before creating any PR, clarifying that the agent must not proceed if compilation fails. Adjusted numbering and formatting, and made minor consistency improvements throughout the document.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

author: Ddemon26
message:
Update agent guidelines for clarity and formatting

Clarified compilation requirements, improved formatting consistency, and updated list styles for better readability. Enhanced instructions for pre-PR checks and code style, and removed redundant or duplicated lines.
pr_title: Codex/rename classes

- Research demonstrates why SIMD doesn't benefit sparse operations
- Valuable for future dense vector scenarios

- Fallback mechanisms for non-SIMD targets
- Integration into existing search pipeline
- Benchmarking infrastructure for performance validation
